text:
Platinum Price in 1999
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1999, the LBMA platinum price rose 28.6% between 1999-01-29 ($345) and 1999-12-30 ($443). The highest sampled price was $443 in December and the lowest was $344 in July. The mean of these observations was $378. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
